diagnosis.hypothesis: Most likely cause is a throughput regression from the recent checkout 1.4.2 production deployment changing connection pool defaults, amplified by the ASG being configured to run only one desired instance. Capacity is technically healthy and at desired count, but there is only one healthy target to absorb load, matching the queue-depth signal and rising latency/error rate.

proposal.target: AWS Auto Scaling Group oape-demo-checkout-asg in ap-southeast-2
proposal.rationale: The ASG is healthy but running only 1 desired/InService instance while checkout is showing latency and queue-depth pressure. Max size is 3, so increasing desired capacity from 1 to 2 is within limits and adds one healthy target to absorb load while the recent deployment regression is investigated.
proposal.blast_radius: Only oape-demo-checkout-asg desired capacity changes from 1 to 2. The ASG should launch exactly one additional checkout EC2 instance and, once healthy, register it in oape-demo-checkout-tg behind the existing ALB. No code deployment, database change, target group change, load balancer change, min_size change, or max_size change is included. Compute cost and checkout serving capacity increase by one instance.
proposal.expected_verification: The post-mutation SELECT must show oape-demo-checkout-asg desired_capacity=2, min_size=1, max_size=3, and eventually 2 InService healthy instances with 2 healthy ALB targets and 0 unhealthy targets.

closeout.summary: Synthetic monitoring fired for oape-checkout reporting p95 latency at 2.4s against a 500ms SLO for 10 minutes with rising error rate, and the signal pointed to growing request queue depth on the only in-service instance. Diagnosis found the ASG was healthy but constrained to 1 desired/1 InService instance with one healthy target, and the issue closely correlated with the recent production deployment of checkout 1.4.2, which changed connection pool defaults. A scale-out from desired capacity 1 to 2 for the oape-demo-checkout-asg in ap-southeast-2 was approved and executed via the rehearsal flag, and verification SELECTs showed desired_capacity=2 with two InService healthy instances (i-090f75449fcbffd62 and i-092070370532713e1) and two healthy ALB targets with no unhealthy targets.
